title: Training Notes: Express Order Supplements and the Age of a Delivery & Pickup Services Plan
content:
**What happens to the supplements an express order carries on a Delivery & Pickup Services plan?**

The supplements the express order carries are added together, and the sum is then adjusted by the age of the plan in whole months from its enrollment date to the day the fee is booked. The express fee is the express speed charge plus the supplements the order still carries once they have been adjusted for the plan's age, rounded to the cent.

**How does the plan's age adjust the sum?**

| Age of the plan on the day the fee is booked | Share of the supplements' sum the order keeps | Rounding of the kept amount |
|---|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | 50 percent | rounded down to the cent |
| at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months | 75 percent | rounded up to the cent |
| fewer than 12 whole months | the whole sum | none needed |

**How is the age counted?** In whole months from the enrollment date shown on the plan to the day the fee is booked. A plan enrolled on 15 March 2022 is 35 whole months old on 14 March 2025 and 36 on 15 March 2025.

**Can you show the working?** Hypothetical supplements totalling $5.15, with a hypothetical express speed charge of 5.592:

| Plan age | Supplements kept | Express fee |
|---|---|---|
| 40 months | 50 percent of 5.15 is 2.575, rounded down to $2.57 | 5.592 plus 2.57 is 8.162, so $8.16 |
| 20 months | 75 percent of 5.15 is 3.8625, rounded up to $3.87 | 5.592 plus 3.87 is 9.462, so $9.46 |
| 8 months | $5.15 | 5.592 plus 5.15 is 10.742, so $10.74 |

**Is the speed charge adjusted for the plan's age too?** No. Only the sum of the supplements is.
